ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the ordering of requests within the same request_type.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume intra-type ordering follows the order in which requests were generated during transaction execution within the block.

ambiguities.text: The security considerations section states 'Needs discussion' without providing concrete analysis.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard security considerations apply: request validation is delegated to CL, EL provides only integrity via hash commitment.

ambiguities.text: Requests derive from 'transaction execution, typically via designated system contracts or event emission' without specifying the exact mechanism.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each request type (defined by other EIPs) specifies its own generation mechanism, and EIP-7685 only provides the framework.

ambiguities.text: No specification for how requests should be handled if the consensus layer rejects them.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume CL rejection does not affect EL block validity; rejected requests are simply not applied to CL state.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution layer is trusted to correctly accumulate and hash all requests generated during block execution.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious or buggy EL client could omit or forge requests, causing CL state divergence.

implicit_assumptions.description: SHA256 provides sufficient collision resistance for the requests_hash commitment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If SHA256 is weakened, attackers could create blocks with colliding requests_hash values for different request sets.

implicit_assumptions.description: Future request types will be defined by subsequent EIPs that specify generation, validation, and processing rules.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Without proper specification of request types, the framework cannot be used for any practical purpose.

implicit_assumptions.description: The opaque byte format for request_data is sufficient to support future encoding schemes without breaking the framework.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Encoding incompatibilities could require framework changes and hard forks.
